title: Quartz website mainly produced by one AI-assisted reporter writing 50+ stories per day
key_facts: Press Gazette says nearly all of Quartz's daily website reporting is credited to one byline, Cris Tolomia, who wrote at least 52 articles on 8 Oct 2026.
The byline has no picture or biography and no contact route; Press Gazette says it appears to belong to a digital marketing expert in the Philippines and did not get a reply to an email.
Press Gazette's own AI detector, MadeByHumans, scored two sampled articles as 100% AI-generated and a third as 85.2%.
A Quartz disclaimer says AI is central to how it reports, with human editorial oversight.
Quartz was bought by the Canadian software firm Redbrick in 2025; Similarweb puts its September 2026 web visitors at about 1.8 million, around a tenth of 2020 traffic.
Press Gazette says Quartz, Redbrick and the owner did not respond to requests for comment.
quote_evidence: Cris Tolomia wrote at least 52 articles on October 8 alone.

A check using MadeByHumans, the multi-function AI detector tool developed by Press Gazette and Flip-Pay, found that a news piece headlined: “Americans’ inflation expectations rose to a three-year high in September, NY Fed says”, appears to be 100% AI-generated.
A disclaimer on the Quartz website says: “AI is central to how Quartz reports, produces, and publishes the news.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows a once well-known business news brand running its site on AI-assisted copy with little human reporting.
notes: The AI-detection results come from Press Gazette's own tool, so they are indicative, not proof. Quartz did not respond.
